core_obligations: Show f^*beta = [X/X/Y]_e circ beta as families of (e+r)-cycles on X/S (proof lines 2893-2898). After unwinding the family-level definitions to the fibres (the composition of families is defined fibrewise by the action), and using that the formation of [X/X/Y]_e is compatible with base change by lemma-family-associated-closed (tag 0H4T), the fibre of the right-hand side over s is [X_s/X_s/Y_s]_e cap beta_s, and the fibre of the left-hand side is f_s^* beta_s; the equality of the two on each fibre is exactly lemma-flat-pullback-as-action (no-tag pointer to source line 2448) (proof lines 2896-2897).
proof_roadmap: Unwind the family-level identity to fibre-wise identities via the definition of the composition (proof lines 2893-2895).
Identify the fibre of the constructed class by the base-change compatibility of the construction (proof lines 2895-2896).
Apply the flat-pullback-as-action lemma on each fibre (proof lines 2896-2897).
